working_definition: Enterocyte-resembling epithelial cells of the gut (Li et al. 2022; Manual Annotation, broad class epithelial cell); a remainder-style '-like' group.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Specialized epithelial cell of the adult gut. A large, polyploid, cuboidal or low-columnar epithelial cell with its nucleus in the middle and a mass of microvilli (brush border) on its apical surface. On its basal side, extensive infoldings of the plasma membrane form a labyrinth which fills the lower half of the cell. It is attached to adjacent enterocytes by smooth septate junctions.

justification: '-like' remainder call mapped to the class the authors commit to (enterocyte), adult variant; gut region not specified so not narrowed to midgut.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Specialized epithelial cell of the adult midgut.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors do not name the midgut.
